components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; color: #334155; } .ds-input { padding: 13px 16px; border: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; background: #f8fafc; color: #0f172a; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.95rem; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #8c6e1c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.08); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-family: Tajawal, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; width: 0; background: #d4af37; border-radius: 2px; transition: width 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-active { color: #8c6e1c; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-active::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d4af37; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is built around the tagline أثرٌ يبقى, Impact that stays. Every surface should feel like work that will still be standing in five years: deep obsidian navy as the ground, champagne gold as the mark left on it, and generous quiet space between them. Nothing is decorative for its own sake; the gold appears where something has been achieved or where the visitor should act.

The system is Arabic-first. Tajawal carries the voice in right-to-left layout, Plus Jakarta Sans takes over in English, and both directions are designed, not mirrored. Density is calm: sections breathe at 100px vertical padding, content sits inside a 1320px container with 24px gutters, and headers stop at 780px wide so headlines read as statements, not banners. A light and a dark theme both exist and both must hold.

This system rejects the old-school IT company look named in PRODUCT.md: clip-art servers and network cables, cluttered pages, stacked banners, dated corporate stock photos, walls of service bullet points. It also refuses to let cost-effectiveness read as "cheap vendor"; restraint and precision are how a fair price looks expensive.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian navy ground, champagne gold mark, slate-cool neutrals.
Arabic-first RTL with first-class English LTR.
Mostly flat surfaces; depth appears in response to the visitor.
Heavy headline weights (800 to 900) against relaxed 1.7 body leading.
One clear action per view: book the free consultation.

rules.name: The Locked Palette Rule
rules.body: The navy and gold values in the frontmatter are final. Never introduce a new hue, never shift these hexes, never "refresh" the palette.

rules.name: The Gold Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Gold marks action or achievement: the primary CTA, the active state, the badge above a heading. If gold appears on something the visitor cannot act on and that does not signal accomplishment, remove it.

rules.name: The Readable Gold Rule
rules.body: On light backgrounds, gold text uses Gold Antique; on navy or dark surfaces, Gold Light or Champagne Gold. Never set Champagne Gold text on white.

rules.name: The One Family Per Language Rule
rules.body: Arabic is set in Tajawal, English in Plus Jakarta Sans. Never mix them inside one sentence-level element; Latin product names inside Arabic text inherit Tajawal.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Headings are 800 to 900, body is 400. Nothing in between competes for attention; 600 is reserved for nav links.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats until the visitor touches it. If a resting card has a visible shadow at arm's length, the shadow is too strong.

dos: Do keep every color exactly as defined in the frontmatter; change usage, never values.
Do design Arabic RTL first, then verify English LTR, including the direction of underlines, icons, and input padding.
Do reserve gold for actions, active states, and earned marks.
Do use Gold Antique (#8c6e1c) for gold text on light backgrounds so it passes WCAG 2.1 AA.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and let shadows answer hover and focus.
Do end every page with the navy CTA band pointing to the free consultation.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for every reveal and hover lift.
donts: Don't look like an old-school IT company: no clip-art servers and network cables, no cluttered pages, no stacked banners, no dated corporate stock photos, no walls of service bullet points.
Don't let low cost read as "cheap vendor": no discount badges, starbursts, or price shouting.
Don't use gradient text. The gold gradient lives on primary buttons only; headings and emphasis use solid gold.
Don't use border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, callouts, or list items.
Don't use glassmorphism beyond the single translucent outline button on the navy hero.
Don't build rows of identical icon-plus-heading cards; vary the structure or use the service-block layout.
Don't put Champagne Gold text on white, or any text other than Ink on Gold on a gold fill.
Don't use WhatsApp Green for anything but the WhatsApp action.
